# Hash-locked install for `build`/`twine`/`setuptools` in the release workflow's `build` job
# (mints the artifact that `attest` then signs -- an unpinned install here is a supply-chain gap:
# a compromised release of any of these packages would execute during CI and land directly in
# the artifact this workflow attests to and (from a later PR) publishes to PyPI). `setuptools`
# is pinned HERE, not left to `python -m build`'s normal isolated-build behavior: an isolated
# build creates a fresh ephemeral environment and does an UNVERIFIED `pip install` of
# `pyproject.toml`'s `[build-system].requires` at build time, bypassing this hash-lock entirely
# -- `build`'s workflow step therefore passes `--no-isolation` so it builds against THIS
# already-hash-verified environment instead. See `.github/workflows/release-please.yml`'s
# `build` job and CodeRabbit's PR #116 finding that closed this gap.
#
# Unlike zizmor-requirements.txt, this pins ONLY the linux-x86_64/cp312 wheels this workflow's
# `build` job actually resolves (release-please.yml: runs-on: ubuntu-latest, actions/setup-python
# python-version: "3.12") -- these packages bring ~27 transitive dependencies vs zizmor's zero,
# so an all-platform pin here would be several times this file's size for platforms this
# workflow never runs on.
#
# `pip download --platform manylinux2014_x86_64 ...` on a NON-Linux machine (e.g. macOS) is NOT
# sufficient to regenerate this file: pip evaluates PEP 508 environment markers (`sys_platform`,
# etc.) against the CURRENT host, not the `--platform` target -- verified by reproducing this
# exact gap: on macOS it silently dropped `keyring`'s `sys_platform == "linux"` dependencies
# (`SecretStorage`, `jeepney`, and their own transitive `cryptography`/`cffi`/`pycparser`), and a
# `pip install --require-hashes --platform ...` "verification" run on the same host gave false
# confidence for the identical reason. Regenerate on a version bump using a REAL Linux
# x86_64 container instead:
#   docker run --rm --platform linux/amd64 -v /tmp/x:/out python:3.12-slim \
#     pip download build twine 'setuptools==<latest satisfying pyproject.toml's [build-system]>' --dest /out
#   shasum -a 256 /tmp/x/*.whl
